browser_verification_notes.paper-route-playtest: Observed full 12-step autoplay victory/return, hint without acting, and mutant counterexample where step 4 falsely delivers only in the mutant. No console errors. Separately, actual local Node engine evidence for fixed seed 20261106 is available at https://github.com/misakamikotoghr-5205/paper-route-playtest/blob/c5392db0e37744014dd9a4e07038e4cc27099341/docs/evidence/README.md: four winning replays and one isolated mutant counterexample. browser_verification_notes.lumen-shift: Observed first-board victory, undo/redo, next-board hint, and completed-board persistence after reload. Replay-allowance hint boundary covered by automated regression.
browser_verification_notes.parallax-postcards: Observed legal reading/navigation/alignment/capture in all three rooms, 3/3 completion, ending and restored progress after reload. No console errors. Canvas2D rendering observed.
browser_verification_notes.patch-review-desk: Isolated agent-capability proposal with two fixture hunks; reviewer approved only the time hunk, applied 09:00 to 09:30 with unapproved final sentence unchanged, then rolled back and restored the original SHA. Real 2:04 screen-only silent Clips recording saved. Anonymous HTTP share/context and four media-frame requests succeeded; authenticated player naturally reached 124.794s end with readyState 4 and no decoding error. Recording is fixture/model off, distinct from the limited real Ollama probe. Builder official form confirmed receipt of the final entry on 2026-11-06; this is not a judging result.
browser_verification_notes.pantry-relay: Actual desktop browser run: source/date gates; explicit review checkbox; tomato 300→100 and eggs4→2 on confirmation; reload retained receipt; undo restored balances and kept reversed receipt; budget1 blocked candidates; new unconfirmed undated20g lot held; real exported JSON reimported as new ledger without trusting historical receipts. Offline deterministic UI, not Alipay, phone/WebView, QMuse deployment or submission. Genuine React version also passed development UI checks including preferences, file import, cross-tab review invalidation and an out-of-stock recipe cost edit. A production UMD bridge loading failure was found, repaired and retained in evidence; actual production confirmation/reload/undo then passed with zero new console errors. Official CLI local preflight accepted19 source files, but no QMuse login/import/release or contest entry.
